exposure: Ultrasound diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The cohort comprised women with placenta previa and a history of at least one prior cesarean section or any other uterine surgery.
finding: Ultrasound diagnosis, particularly the presence of bladder interruption and subplacental hypervascularity, demonstrated high concordance with surgical findings for detecting and classifying placenta accreta spectrum.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (for ultrasound diagnosis) and at the time of surgical correlation (Aug 2023 to Apr 2024).
